tools.name: my_access
tools.description: Returns this token's plan and the artists it covers. A null artist list means every artist and store. Call it first to learn what you can read.

tools.name: list_artists
tools.description: Lists the artists and brands this token reads, ordered by popularity, then name. Each has an id, slug, category, image, Dropify page and store count. Use it to find an artist's id or slug before you filter other tools.

tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: Lists the stores this token reads, with name, store URL, region, currency and artist. Pass an artist to get only that artist's stores. Regions are US, UK, EU, CA, AU, JP and KR. Use it to find a store id.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Lists products, newest first, with name, price, currency, stock, image and store link. Filter by artist, store or stock. Pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page. Use search_products when you have words to match.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Returns one product by id. Each variant, such as a size, has its own price, stock and quantity. Use it after a list or search when you need stock by size. Quantity is null unless the store's count is known.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Searches products by word and returns the same fields as list_products. Use it when someone names an item, like a hoodie or a vinyl. Narrow it with artist, store or in_stock. A search across every store ranks by best match. Within an artist or store, results list newest first.

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Returns the change feed, newest first. It covers restocks, new drops, price drops and rises, sell-outs and stock changes. Each change has its product, store, artist and time.
